market.question: Will any Category 4 hurricane make landfall in the US in before 2027?

assessment.reasoning: 2026 season forecast leans below-average (CSU: 13/6/2 majors; El Niño expected), though some forecasters disagree (UofA 4 majors). Cat-4 US landfalls occur in roughly 30-40% of years historically. Lean modestly below long-run base rate due to El Niño suppression.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast track uncertainty dominates — one Cat-4 landfall is enough
